site.title: Cobble Hill Plumbing and Heating
site.description: Same-day plumbing, heating and cooling service across the county, since 1994.
site.markdown:
# Cobble Hill Plumbing and Heating

Same-day plumbing, heating and cooling service across the county. Two branches, 60 technicians, trucks stocked for most repairs on the first visit.

## Book online

Pick a service and a time window. Our booking widget shows live availability. Powered by Routeboard.

## Careers

We are hiring dispatchers for both branches. Two years of experience with Routeboard or a similar dispatch system preferred. Technicians: apply with your license number.

## Services

Water heaters, drain cleaning, furnace repair, AC installs, maintenance plans.

evidence: The Book online page says its booking widget is powered by Routeboard.
The careers page asks dispatcher applicants for two years of experience with Routeboard or a similar system.

data.headline: Tidewell next to Routeboard, for Cobble Hill
data.intro: Your site names Routeboard: the booking widget runs on it and your dispatcher openings ask for it. Below is how Tidewell lines up with it on the seven things a dispatch team touches every day. Routeboard is the better fit on two rows, Tidewell on four, and one is a wash.
data.them_fit: Stay with Routeboard if most of your jobs come in through the booking widget on your site, or if someone on your team builds their own reports and would miss the report builder and the per-branch dashboard.
data.us_fit: Tidewell is the better fit if your day changes after 8 am and you want the board and the technician's phone to move together, if your technicians lose signal in basements, and if you want to be live in two weeks rather than six to eight.
